title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Strengthening the Construction of Judicial Police Forces in People's Courts in the New Era
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Judicial Police Teams of People's Courts in the New Era

Fa Fa [2022] No. 38

The people's police of our country are an important national force for public security administration and criminal justice. The judicial police of the people's courts (hereinafter referred to as judicial police) are one of the types of police among the people's police and are the only armed law enforcement force established by the state in the people's courts. The main tasks of judicial police are to maintain order in trial and enforcement proceedings, protect the lawful rights and interests of litigation participants, prevent, stop, and handle acts that disrupt trial and enforcement order, and ensure the safe and orderly conduct of trial and enforcement work in the people's courts. Strengthening the construction of judicial police teams in the new era is an inevitable requirement for thoroughly implementing the Party Central Committee's decisions and deployments on the work of the people's police and the Party's principles for building and governing the police in the new era. It is an important measure for upholding the Party's absolute leadership over judicial work. It is of great significance for strengthening and improving judicial police work, ensuring the complete and accurate implementation of the law, promoting the high-quality development of the work of the people's courts in the new era, accelerating the construction of a fair, efficient, and authoritative socialist judicial system, and achieving the goal of enabling the people to feel fairness and justice in every judicial case. To strengthen the construction of judicial police teams in the new era, promote the modernization of judicial police work, and serve and ensure the high-quality development of the work of the people's courts in the new era, the following opinions are hereby put forward.

1. General Requirements

(1) Guiding Ideology. Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, deeply study, publicize, and implement the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, fully implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law and the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions to the police, always adhere to the direction of revolutionization, regularization, specialization, and professionalization of judicial police team construction, vigorously promote the great spirit of Party building, cultivate the spirit of heroes and models, craftsmanship spirit, and professional spirit within the judicial police team, and strive to build a high-quality judicial police iron army with iron-like ideals and beliefs, iron-like responsibility, iron-like excellent skills, and iron-like discipline and work style.

(2) Objectives and Tasks. Build a judicial police team with more comprehensive systems, more scientific management, more standardized law enforcement, more professional training, stricter discipline, and stronger guarantees. Always adhere to and improve the dual leadership and formation management system and mechanism for judicial police. Strengthen political and ideological construction, adhere to the policy of building the police politically, and strictly enforce political discipline and political rules. Strengthen capacity building for performing duties, adhere to strict, standardized, fair, and civilized law enforcement, and improve the rule of law level and law enforcement credibility of judicial police work. Strengthen discipline and work style construction, adhere to comprehensive strict governance of the police, and use a strict tone to strengthen positive discipline and suppress corruption. Improve policies for treating the police favorably, perfect the system of training, using, managing, and guaranteeing judicial police, and do a good job of caring for and warming the police.

2. Strengthening Political and Ideological Construction

(3) Forging Loyalty to the Police Soul. Adhere to the Party's absolute leadership, deeply understand the decisive significance of the "Two Establishments," enhance the "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen the "Four Confidences," and achieve the "Two Upholds." Always take the Party's banner as our banner, the Party's direction as our direction, and the Party's will as our will. Resolutely obey the Party Central Committee's orders and commands, ensuring absolute loyalty, absolute purity, and absolute reliability. Establish and improve a regular ideological education mechanism, integrate General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions to the police and the judicial police oath into regular ideological education, continuously promote the normalization and institutionalization of Party history learning and education, and guide all judicial police to draw strong spiritual strength from Party history.

(4) Strengthen the Leadership of Party Building. Strengthen the construction of grassroots Party organizations in judicial police departments. Judicial police departments that meet the conditions should establish independent grassroots Party organizations. Effectively leverage the political and organizational functions of grassroots Party organizations, strengthen political guidance, ideological guidance, and supervision and management, and guide all judicial police to effectively enhance their political judgment, political understanding, and political execution. Actively explore new paths for the integrated development of Party building work and judicial police professional work, ensuring the comprehensive implementation of the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and higher-level Party organizations.

(5) Improve the Incentive System. Broadly carry out activities for judicial police to learn from advanced models, creating a strong atmosphere of respecting, learning from, and caring for heroes and models. Increase the selection, cultivation, and publicity of advanced models, comprehensively considering factors such as political literacy, law enforcement performance, and business innovation to deeply discover outstanding police teams and individuals. The Supreme People's Court and each Higher and Intermediate People's Court shall regularly organize the selection of advanced collectives and advanced individuals among judicial police, promoting a good situation where old models drive new models and regional models grow into national models.

(6) Focus on Cultivating Police Culture. Based on the professional characteristics of judicial police, guided by police service needs, carry out targeted police camp cultural construction to further凝聚警心 (unite police spirit) and boost morale. Hold judicial police honor ceremonies at important career junctures such as joining the police, receiving awards and honors, being awarded (promoted in) police ranks, and reaching certain years of service, playing the judicial police song. Seriously carry out themed activities for "People's Police Day." Actively establish police camp cultural corridors, honor rooms (walls), and team history exhibition rooms (walls). Strengthen the construction of judicial police publicity positions, forming a publicity carrier combining internal publications, court-specific networks, and internet platforms.

3. Strengthening Capacity Building for Performing Duties

(7) Improve Standardized Law Enforcement Capacity. Scientifically determine the job post and staffing numbers for judicial police, strictly implement the access system, establish and improve a convenient mechanism for recruiting judicial police, and continuously increase the proportion of graduates majoring in police science. Deeply promote the standardized construction of judicial police law enforcement, effectively implement strict, standardized, fair, and civilized law enforcement, and continuously improve the rule of law level and law enforcement credibility of judicial police work. Further improve the law enforcement system, explore the establishment of a case evaluation mechanism, a mechanism for protecting lawful rights and interests, and a system of exemption from liability for performing duties according to law. Deepen the training of judicial police law enforcement capability, grasp the "key minority" of heads of judicial police departments, highlight political standards, ensure they take the lead in respecting the rule of law, revering the law, understanding the law, and mastering the law, making respecting, studying, abiding by, and using the law a conscious behavior and necessary quality for judicial police, and continuously improve their ability to use rule of law thinking and rule of law methods to prevent and resolve risks, understand and handle problems. Relying on the construction of discipline systems and professional textbooks, scientifically plan issues such as the setting of majors, curriculum systems, textbook compilation, and joint training at various levels of academic education, with a focus on cultivating the ability of judicial police to perform their duties according to law.

(8) Improve Actual Combat Training Capability. Solidly promote the systematic, standardized, professional, and practical construction of the judicial police training system, adhere to political leadership in training, training according to law, training guided by demand, training revitalized by science and technology, and strict training. Taking new police training, promotion training, professional training, technical and tactical training, and development training as main contents, scientifically use centralized training, post-based training, simulation drills, online training, competition and contests, rotation training and duty, etc., to build a practical training system that responds to demands, adapts to actual combat, and covers the career. Formulate the "Training Regulations for Judicial Police of the People's Courts," and revise the "Training Outline for Judicial Police of the People's Courts." Strengthen the construction of instructor teams, study and formulate management measures for the talent pool of police instructors, improve and perfect mechanisms for cross-regional joint training of instructor talent, cooperative construction, and exchange exercise, and strive to build a team of practical instructors that are well-known nationwide and recognized in the police community. Promote the construction of full-time and part-time professional teacher teams for judicial police majors, and explore the establishment of working mechanisms for professional teachers to be stationed in police teams for practice, sending training to police teams, and selecting professional instructors from police teams as resident instructors in schools.

(9) Improve Science and Technology Application Capability. Adhere to the path of revitalizing the police through science and technology, firmly establish the concept of seeking police force and combat effectiveness from science and technology. Strengthen the research, development, and application of judicial police smart policing such as intelligent early warning, mobile office, visual management, and data analysis. Timely update the judicial police equipment catalog, actively promote the modernization of judicial police equipment, continuously advance the informatization and intelligent construction of judicial police work, and promote the leap from "sweat policing" to "smart policing." Strengthen the construction and equipment of safety prevention facilities in people's courts, with a focus on improving the scientific and technological level of safety prevention facilities and equipment in rural courts. Strengthen training for judicial police in the application of science and technology, promote the interconnection of network platforms, co-construction and sharing of training resources, and mutual selection and learning of training courses, and cultivate a group of backbone talents with refined business and strong capabilities. The Supreme People's Court shall timely promote scientific and technological innovations carried out by people's courts at all levels in response to the needs of judicial police work, especially innovative achievements closely related to the safety of trial and enforcement.

(10) Improve Theoretical Research Capability. Promote theoretical research on judicial police work based on practice, forming a strong atmosphere of researching, applying, and innovating judicial police theory. The Supreme People's Court shall continuously promote theoretical research on judicial police work, organize activities such as judicial police research projects, teaching skills competitions, and selection of quality courses, and organize a selection of theoretical essays on judicial police every two years, promptly summarizing and promoting theoretical research results of judicial police work. Each Higher and Intermediate People's Court shall regularly organize theoretical seminars and exchanges on judicial police work, and judicial police departments shall actively participate in relevant activities, with department heads taking the lead in conducting theoretical research.

4. Strengthening Discipline and Work Style Construction

(11) Focus on Discipline Education. Implement the general requirements for Party building in the new era, unswervingly adhere to comprehensive strict governance of the Party and the police, adhere to a strict tone to strengthen positive discipline and suppress corruption, and consolidate and deepen the results of the political and legal team education and rectification work. Strictly enforce the "Three Provisions" on preventing interference in judicial work, the "Ten Prohibitions" for political and legal police officers in the new era, and other ironclad rules and prohibitions, and strictly abide by confidentiality regulations.

(12) Focus on Rule of Law Education. Further strengthen the rule of law concept of the judicial police team, vigorously promote the spirit of socialist rule of law, cultivate the rule of law belief of judicial police, enhance the pertinence and effectiveness of rule of law education for judicial police, and guide judicial police to become faithful advocates, conscious abiders, and steadfast defenders of socialist rule of law.

(13) Focus on Work Style Education. Persistently implement the spirit of the Central Committee's Eight-Point Regulation, continuously deepen the correction of the "Four Forms of Decadence," focus on correcting formalism and bureaucracy, and adhere to the "Three Stricts and Three Honests." Regularly organize work style warning education, using warning cases to clarify bottom lines and sound alarms. Focus on inspecting the police appearance and discipline management of judicial police at posts such as security checks, case filing and petitions, guarding court sessions, and escorting detainees, promote the cultivation of judicial police work style, and effectively establish a good image.

5. Improving Policies for Treating the Police Favorably

(14) Consolidate Basic Projects. Actively smooth the channels for rank promotion of judicial police, ensure the implementation of relevant treatment. Seriously implement the "Administrative Measures for Special Subsidies for Casualties of the People's Police," and do a good job of providing pensions for injured or disabled police officers. Encourage judicial police to improve their comprehensive literacy through methods such as participating in on-the-job education and qualification examinations, creating a "learning-type" police team.

(15) Enrich Work Measures. Actively broaden the career development paths for judicial police, actively promote the exchange and appointment of judicial police to other posts. Implement the regular physical examination system, optimize physical examination items according to the health status of judicial police of different ages, ensuring that each judicial police officer receives at least one comprehensive physical examination each year. Improve and perfect the psychological counseling mechanism for judicial police, pay attention to the mental health status of judicial police, and list mental health assessment as a routine item in judicial police recruitment and regular physical examinations.

(16) Increase Special Service Guarantees. Further improve the guarantee system for judicial police performing special duties, truly achieving special treatment and special care. Each Higher and Intermediate People's Court shall provide psychological counseling and health recuperation for judicial police performing special duties, and encourage units with conditions to improve guarantee treatments such as special duty subsidies, shift adjustments and compensatory rest, and health care.

6. Strengthening Implementation Measures

(17) Strengthen Organizational Leadership. Party groups of people's courts at all levels must fully recognize the importance of strengthening the construction of judicial police teams in the new era, place the construction of judicial police teams in the context of the long-term construction of the court cadre team, the high-quality development of court work, the complete and accurate implementation of the law, and the realization of the goal of enabling the people to feel fairness and justice in every judicial case. Effectively play the important role of setting the direction, managing the overall situation, and ensuring implementation, and treat strengthening the construction of judicial police teams in the new era as an important foundational task to be done solidly and well.

(18) Seriously Implement. Relevant departments of people's courts at all levels must attach great importance to and strongly support the construction of judicial police teams in the new era. Political departments must effectively supervise, manage, and guide the implementation of judicial police organization and management regulations by this court and lower courts. Judicial administrative equipment management (comprehensive) departments must provide material foundation guarantees related to work. Judicial police departments must raise their ideological awareness, actively take initiative, and promote the implementation of the opinions. Each Higher People's Court shall, based on these opinions and in light of the specific circumstances of its region, study and formulate specific implementation opinions.

December 26, 2022
